title: Count the islands
prompt: Read a map from standard input: lines of equal length made of `#` (land) and `.` (water). An island is a group of land cells connected through their eight neighbours (the cells that touch it by a side or by a corner). Print `islands=K largest=A`, where K is the number of islands and A the number of cells of the biggest one (0 when there is no land). An input without any line is a map without land.
